title: Add immutable O(1) active Site lookup for Multi-Site health operations

opportunity.rootCause: The active Site lookup in POST /api/sites/{id}/health scanned registry.Current.Sites with FirstOrDefault on every request, producing O(S) work as the number of configured Sites grew.
opportunity.scope: SiteRegistry and the Multi-Site health endpoint

implementation: Added an immutable per-runtime-snapshot, case-insensitive Site ID dictionary held in an atomically replaced registry state.
Changed the health endpoint to use TryGetById instead of scanning all active Sites.
Kept snapshot replacement and Resolve behavior consistent while preserving the existing invalid-activation rollback boundary.

tddRed.reason: The health endpoint still used FirstOrDefault and had no registry index contract.

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL and concurrent multi-instance mutation execution
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
